formula: {metric}_z ~ is_female + is_sft + is_dpo + is_rlvr + is_female:is_sft + is_female:is_dpo + is_female:is_rlvr + C(occupation) + is_university + C(temperature) * (is_sft + is_dpo + is_rlvr)
gender_label_caveat: is_female in this file is inferred from the model's own response by a classifier, not a ground-truth profile attribute. It is a collider on the path from alignment stage to text properties, so conditioning on it can induce association even where none exists. Model A' tests whether model/temperature shift this predicted label; Model B' coefficients on is_female should be read as 'conditional on the model having assumed this gender', not as a causal effect of gender.
